runner: Existing Playwright one worker; real Chromium and xterm, synthetic native IPC.
environment: Shared Windows PC, Chromium/xterm and explicit IPC fixtures; one worker, zero retries. Before is frozen 8bf0908 source; after is product correction, identical test bytes. No physical Windows IME or actual CLI.

cases.scenario: IME09 immediate search-open/input before ResizeObserver; IME10 same-query after selection loss/reopen/session switch; IME11 composer/search focusout recovery; IME12-14 extension/relay/catalog flags, 229 and composition sequence.
cases.entryPoint: Real DOM handlers, xterm terminal resize/selection, captured fixture IPC calls
cases.expectedBehavior: Search retains its selection after opening layout settles; same Korean term searches current terminal; composition never runs app actions and focusout restores ordinary actions.
cases.oracle: Exact xterm selection coordinates before/after real rAF; no IPC during composition and one ordinary action after blur/end.
cases.sensitivityReason: Read raw before/after assertions against same tests; do not claim signed proof or physical IME.

exclusions: No CLI changes; CLI-owned defects deferred to next version.
Physical Windows IME, actual WebView2/CLI, final Core pairing and full release acceptance remain separate.
